label: prf:frobenius-lepton-meson-bridge
title: Proof of frobenius lepton meson bridge
html:
Proof. The branching rule H_3 \downarrow H_2 follows from the Pieri / Littlewood–Richardson rule for removing a box from the Young diagram. For each partition \lambda \vdash 3:

  V_{(3)} \downarrow = V_{(2)}, \qquad
  V_{(2,1)} \downarrow = V_{(2)} \oplus V_{(1,1)}, \qquad
  V_{(1^3)} \downarrow = V_{(1,1)}.

The standard representation (2,1) admits removal of a box from either the first row (giving (2)) or the second row (giving (1,1)), hence the two-term decomposition. \square
